lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: No. You really, i-if you know where the knife is, you have ta tell us. OK? Where is the knife?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don't know where it is.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he tell you what he did with the knife?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. So after you guys had done this and we come out there and we close off the property, remember? You guys go up north.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: And I was told you guys were talking about this up north. Right?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. So what did you guys talk about?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Well, when the cops came up there he was tryin' ta hide and, and then grandpa said if he was hiding that he, he was acting like he did it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Mm huh. Well, what was the conversation like between you and him? I mean was he tellin' you, we can't tell anybody or what was he telling you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: That not ta talk to the cops.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. What else did he tell you? Were you afraid that the cops were gonna be onto ya?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: So how long before this, that well let's go back OK to the couple days prior to this happening. OK? You said you guys talked about this and planned this. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. Did he tell you about Teresa, that he had met her before?
